obernants.observation_scope: One terminating call or the named finite test suite.
obernants.operator: Public size caps precede input-order validation, then arithmetic/search. Exact cover budget exhaustion is not infeasibility; closure capacity overflow is not infeasibility. Bounded index arithmetic cannot overflow. Checked i128 arborescence arithmetic remains defensive. Allocation failure is process-level, not returned; no callbacks or external writes. Empty cases and deterministic ties follow API docs.
